guide.title: Meet Mukta Patil — Nutritionist & Founder, Eat Rrite
guide.text: Mukta didn’t set out to become a nutritionist — she became one because she had to. Eat Rrite began from her own health crisis: postpartum weight gain, crash diets, and body-shaming that failed her. Eight years on, her mission is unchanged — helping women heal, in mind and body, without fear, judgment, or fads.
points: 8 years in practice across Hyderabad & Dehradun
Focus areas: hormonal health, diabetes reversal, weight & lifestyle management
Science-backed, culturally-rooted coaching — food you already eat, not a fad diet

investment.title: One consultation. A clearer way forward.
investment.text: ₹800 is a single conversation with Mukta about your hormones, weight, and energy. You leave knowing what is driving the symptoms and what to change first. That is money put toward getting well — not another month spent managing the same problem.

items.q: Is the ₹800 consultation fee adjusted against the program fee?
items.a: No. It's a one-time fee for the 30-minute consultation itself, separate from any program you choose afterward.

items.q: I've tried diets before and nothing stuck. What's different here?
items.a: Most diets treat the symptom — weight, cravings — without asking why it’s happening. Mukta starts with your actual hormones, labs, and lifestyle, so the plan fits what your body needs, not a generic chart.

items.q: Do I need blood tests done before I book?
items.a: No. That's exactly what the consultation is for — Mukta will guide you on which tests make sense for you, if any, after hearing your history.

items.q: What if this cohort's slots are full or I miss the 5th?
items.a: A new cohort of 10 opens every month. WhatsApp us at +91 96398 77483 and we’ll let you know when the next one opens.

items.q: Am I committing to the full program by booking the consultation?
items.a: No. Booking only confirms your 30-minute consultation. Continuing into a 30/90/180-day program is a separate choice you make after.
